rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: M.V.K. Agro Food Product Limited has informed the Exchange about commencement of enhanced cane crushing capacity of 4,000 TCD and inauguration of the new plant.

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: M.V.K. Agro Food Product Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 14, 2026.

rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 74(5) of the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018, we enclose herewith the certificate received from Mas Services Limited, Registrar and Share Transfer Agent ( RTA ) of the Company for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
